5d603760a2b4e1fc9e47.text: *What are beliefs and convictions?   *What words, phrases or expressions do  we usually use in expressing our beliefs  and convictions?

83f6df864426c3d7a24e.text: BELIEF is something that an individual considers as the truth. It is shaped by the

173ce2a5e3eacba7405a.text: individual’s background experiences and is based on one’s cultural or personal faith, morality, or values.

da924b359146f0cf65db.text: CONVICTION is a firm belief on something that an individual is convinced of. To be

98658a43755fda46be44.text:
convinced you need to obtain all related information like

statistical data - based on analysis of statistics;

observational data - based on what the person has observed or perceived
they observed

causal data - based on what fact has caused a particular factual result; and

experiential data - based on what experience shows can be inferred from the
facts.
A conviction remains the same even with new experiences and even after long
periods of time because it is built in concrete information.

5c5bede0cc0009e90d35.text: Basic Signal Phrases in Expressing Beliefs or Convictions

labels.text: My point of view is that…

a566fbd28d5d2ab1c325.text:  I feel…   I think…   I believe that…   In my opinion…   From my point of view…   In my view…   I really feel that…   Personally, I think…   Personally speaking…   My point of view is that…

8ca8cf1b4869fd3db99e.text: As you form convictions/beliefs about materials you viewed, it is best to familiarize yourself with some examples of visual materials.

66171c0927c6ca4892e4.text:
The term visual materials encompass a wide range of forms including
photographs, cinema, cartoons, prints, designs and three-dimensional art such as
sculpture and architecture.
Just as in reading, writing and speaking, viewing entails giving attention to
facts, relationships, inferences, and to critical analysis. Understanding visual images
can connect to accompanying spoken or written language like expressing your own
beliefs or convictions to a particular subject.

0232c75cb52c64d52aac.text: Video gives you a chance to show stimulating visual information. Use video to bring movement, pictures and sound into your presentation. Always make sure that the clip is directly relevant to your content. Tell your audience what to look for. Avoid showing any more film than you need.

3f05ea5d47a3a9c127c9.text: Drawing is creating a picture with a variety of tools like pencils, crayons, pens or markers. Artists draw on different types of surfaces, like paper or canvas.

3070c296a0c6fc862844.text: Painting is often called the most important form of visual art. It is about putting colors on a canvas or a wall. Painters express their ideas through a mixture of colors and different brush strokes. It is also one of the oldest forms of visual arts.

142ec946edab4dcf5fca.text: Photography is making pictures by letting light pass through the lenses of a camera onto a film. Images could then be printed onto special paper.

145be1b45119d2cae008.text: Today, most photography is digital. Cameras have no film; the images are recorded onto silicon chips.

87865049ac5922ac4ba7.text: Filmmaking is the process of directing and producing movies for television and cinemas. It is a very expensive and complicated form of art, involving many tasks, for example scriptwriting, casting and editing film sequences before they can be shown to an audience.

273ad29520363d8caa62.text: Sculptures are three-dimensional pieces of art that are created by shaping various kinds of material. Among the popular sculpting materials are steel, plastic, ceramics and wood. Sculpture is often referred to as plastic arts.

63ac0d067279c308cc96.text: Cartoon is a type of illustration, sometimes animated, typically in a non- realistic or semi-realistic style. Cartoons are drawings and illustrations that come in several forms and can have many meanings. One type of cartoon is drawings and illustrations in magazines or newspapers. Another type is animated or audio-visual cartoon films that contain sound, voices and attractive animated drawings. As a result, a cartoon film can be close to real life, because visual clues and contexts can make it possible to view the messages as much more real especially as the viewers can listen to the voice overs.
